text:
Friendly night or not, we value your second message and we have reviewed the concern about your companion animal's handling during the journey and the delay in the follow-up you expected.

We are sorry that the experience felt disjointed. The Companion Animal Travel Desk takes care to record each report, pass it to the ground team, and keep the handoff between services as calm and careful as possible. When a traveler feels left without a clear update, that falls short of the service we aim to provide, and we understand why that would be upsetting.

Your note has been added to the record for review, with attention to the condition of the carrier, the transfer between staff, and the communication that followed. The ground team moves carriers carefully between services, and this work is treated as a shared responsibility across the travel path. Even so, we know that careful handling must be matched by timely, respectful contact so that you are not left worrying about your animal's well-being.

We are also checking whether the information passed along at the desk matched what was seen on arrival. If anything in the chain of care was unclear, we will address it with the staff involved so that the next trip reflects the standard expected at Aurelia Skyways. Our records show that concerns like yours are most useful when they are reviewed in full, because they help us improve both procedure and communication.

Please be assured that your complaint has been formally noted and that the Companion Animal Travel Desk will continue following up through the usual internal channels. We appreciate that a pet is part of the family, and we take that responsibility seriously. If a further review is needed, it will be handled with the same careful record keeping used for all companion animal travel matters.

Thank you for taking the time to write again and for giving us the chance to look into this properly. We remain committed to steadier service and clearer updates for every traveler.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
